shortDescription: Three z-levels (sky/surface/basement) in ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling/needs/work/storage come free from vanilla. Per-band biomes, Caverns basements, ~4× faster gen, full-mesh elevator — sky mountains use vanilla rock sprites over a textured rough-stone floor, with despeckled generation, one central fog hole, a five-terrain plateau and south-facing cliff faces. Ledges/plateaus confirmed good in play.
body:
# As above, So below II — V2

> V1 is **DELETED**. Current tree: ~57 files / ~12,800 LOC.

## Pitch
Three z-levels (sky / surface / basement) in ONE RimWorld `Map`. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky, (2) performance, (3) full vanilla parity.

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`; bands along **+z**; permanently-fogged gutter between bands; `Slot = ceil((bandHeight+2)/64)×64` — **64-alignment is load-bearing**. Map sizes curated (126 / 190 / 254).

### The one insight
`Region.Neighbors` is **topological, not spatial**. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between one-cell `RegionType.Portal` ends conduct connectivity without merging rooms/temperature/vacuum; `Reachability.CanReach` works **unpatched** — we patch nothing in `Reachability`/`PathFinder`/region traversal.

### Dividing line
Graph/logic = FREE. Geometry/presentation = NOT free; fix per draw/compute site. Reachability-as-proxy consumers (wander roots fixed; joy/meditation/pens un-audited).

### Hard 1.6 constraints
Jobified pathfinder · no `PathFinder.FindPath` · `BlocksDiagonalMovement` trips on unwalkable cells.

### Generation-window rules
Carve in `GenerateContentsIntoMap` postfix · `TryPendingSurfaceRect` for genstep-time band math · start-spot clamp + `RescueStrandedColonists` + `CarveStartClearing` on zero-standable surfaces (also fires on ocean tiles; "solid rock" wording is a mislabel).

# 2. ⚠ THE LOAD BOUNDARY (root-caused, fix pending verification)
Cache poisoning: `ConstructComponents()` creates a transient EMPTY `ABBandMap` that mid-load rendering latches. Fix: `CompOf` never caches while `Scribe.mode != Inactive` + `FinalizeInit` rebinds all caches. Also: uniqueID-keyed statics → CWT; load camera move deferred. **Verify: menu-load · load-while-playing · double cycle.**

# 3. PER-BAND BIOME / CAVERNS — verified
`GetBiomeAt` prefix (cell param) · sky biome locked to surface · `SeedFlora` on plateau cells · Biomes! Caverns basements. Watch: perf-mod biome caching · stalagmite leak · Earthen Depths temp.

# 4. CAMERA — verified. `viewBand` · `CurrentViewRect` clip · `ABBandCurtain` = `MapEdgeMaterial` at WorldClipper altitude.

# 5. MAP GEN — ~4× faster, closed (crowdedness mechanism; doomed-band plant skip).

# 6. RUNTIME PERF — 59.6 fps @96 pawns, mod ≈2% frame. Every visual system is bake-time section-mesh geometry: zero per-frame cost.

# 7. SEE-BELOW / BORDER STACK
Event-driven sky sync; below-draw prints + translates (one big map, no DrawPos lies). Shared `ABNineFan` (vanilla 9-vert cell fan). Below fog = vanilla corner smoothing sampled one band down · below edge shadows via `ABEdgeShadowGeometry` (verbatim vanilla corner blocks, extracted once) · meadow fade = neighbour ground's own world-position material as a fade fan over the mass cell · rooftop fade via TerrainHard→TerrainFadeRough shader-swapped clone + AlphaAddTex (**shader assignment resets renderQueue — set queue after**) · drop-off EdgeShadow ring in open-air cells bordering the mass.

# 8. SKY-MASS PRESENTATION — settled; **user verdict: "everything looks great"** except one ore bug, now fixed
Options mocked up in `docs/mockups/ledge-options.html` (real vanilla pixels cropped from playtest screenshots + honest feasibility/perf scoring). User chose **A+B now**, D next, E after a water spike, C parked.

### ⚠ THREE REJECTED ATTEMPTS — do not revisit
1. **Force-linked wall masks** (run 25): flattened the wall band into the atlas' near-flat mask-15 tile — "square gray instead of rock".
2. **High-queue cover** (atlas tiles above cutout+fog): **shipped regression** — erased every overhanging sprite (tree tops, plants); mask-15 interiors read as a flat slab.
3. **Wall-sprite suppression + fog re-predicate + shadow scoping** (`ABSkyMassShadowScope`, DELETED): rendered beautifully, broke *legibility* — minable rock read as walkable floor (the wall/floor lip is load-bearing gameplay information), and it also carried two vanilla-layer replacements as permanent compat risk.

**Settled: vanilla sprites always draw; redundant outlines are a GENERATION problem.**
- **Standing rock renders natively.** Cap layer skips cells holding a natural-rock edifice (opaque sprite ⇒ field would be waste) and skips fogged cells (vanilla's to draw).
- **Despeckle** (`ABSkyBandGen.Despeckle`, 2 passes): the actual cause of nested rings — two noise fields crossed at cell resolution speckled the mass into dozens of 1–2 cell stubs and pinholes, each a real boundary vanilla correctly decorates. Majority filter (wall with ≥6 open neighbours dissolves; floor with ≥6 wall neighbours fills). **Conversions require all 8 neighbours in-mass (⇒ edgeDist ≥ 2), so the rim and the ledge-band invariant are untouched.**
- **One central fog hole** (`ComputeFogMask`): wall depth ≥3 measured out of everything non-wall, components <24 cells dropped.

### Option A — terrace ring + plateau palette ✅ verified in play
- **Ledge band ≥1 cell is an invariant**: plateau requires `edgeDist ≥ 2`, `TerraceWidth()` never returns <1.
- **Five-terrain palette** from fertility noise × an INDEPENDENT moisture Perlin: rough stone → gravel → soil → **rich soil** at moisture peaks → **mud** in wettest hollows (>0.90, rare). All natural + FadeRough ⇒ vanilla blends ground↔ground free.
- Field underlay on OPEN mass cells: rock's `naturalTerrain`, world-position sampled, uv-FREE quads at `lowQueue`; atlas edge tiles at `lowQueue+1` only when mask≠15.

### Option B — south-facing cliff face ✅ verified in play
`CliffFaceDepth = 2` (0 disables), `FaceDarkest = 0.42`. Southern rim cells carry a vertical brightness ramp on field quad + edge tile + corner fillers. **Vertex colour multiplies the terrain shader, so rock detail stays visible down the face.** Face lives inside rim cells we own (open-air cells belong to see-below sprites at cutout queue).

### ORE GLYPH BUG (fixed 2026-07-29) — "compacted steel looks like strange text"
Root cause was OURS, not vanilla context (first diagnosis was wrong): `GroundRockAt` accepted any `def.mineable` edifice below, **including ore**. `TerrainDefGenerator_Stone` only generates `_Rough` terrain for `!isResourceRock`, so **ore defs have `naturalTerrain == null`** ⇒ the "never happens" fallback fired ⇒ it drew `AtlasBaseFor(ore)`, which is the **whole linked atlas SHEET**, on a 0..1-uv full-cell quad ⇒ every sub-tile crammed per cell, repeating as glyph soup.
**Fix:** `IsHostStone()` gate (mineable && !isResourceRock && naturalTerrain != null) on both `GroundRockAt` branches — the top above a vein types from its HOST STONE — and the atlas-base fallback **deleted outright** (an atlas base is only ever valid via `MaterialAtlasPool.SubMaterialFromAtlas`; worst case now is a dull cap-terrain cell, never a wrong one). Lore saved.

# 9. VERTICAL LINKS — elevator SHIPPED (untested). Full-mesh 2×2 `AB2_Elevator`; shaft collapse; legacy-save migration. Known: `Carry` latent hole.

# 10. BETTER MOUNTAINS COMPAT — code-complete, co-load test deferred. Variant mode + live-graphic caches + live `ABMinedRockLookup` colour + field uses BM-rebuilt naturalTerrain live.

# 11. DIAGNOSTICS
band info · transit health · below pawn report · stuck probe · watchdog · transit logging · below layer report · lighting report · bisect toggles · biome report · shader report · ABGenProfile · cap corner filler toggle · `CliffFaceDepth`.

# 12. OPEN WORK
1. **Confirm the ore fix** (compacted steel + gold/machinery veins on the sky band and above surface veins read vanilla; mountain top above a vein shows host stone).
2. **Verify reload fix** (menu-load, load-while-playing, double cycle).
3. **Verify elevator**.
4. **Option D — alpine plateau** (next up): per-biome flora, scree near rim, tarns interior-only (never within N cells of a drop), optional snow line. **Needs a density budget + measured gen delta** (plant spawning was the gen cost driver, 16.9 s → 4.2 s).
5. **Option E — waterfalls**: river raised at gen, lower level filled to perimeter, fall lip = raised water adjacent to `ShowsBelow`, capped/zoom-gated mist flecks + sustainer. **Water spike FIRST** — below-view water rendering is the unproven risk.
6. Option C (stepped mesa) parked · COMBAT never verified · mountain sun-shadow (parked) · vertical conduit · compat audit · transplant · reachability-proxy audit.

# 13. LESSONS (telegraphic)
Measure, don't reason · crowdedness drives destroy cost · reuse the engine's object · fog softness lives in EXPLORED neighbours' fans · classify terrain by PROPERTY not def identity · **NEVER hide sprites that carry gameplay information — the wall/floor lip IS vanilla's language for "standing rock above walkable ground"** · **visual noise in a generated field is a GENERATION bug: despeckle the content, don't hide the decoration** · **ore defs have no naturalTerrain/leaveTerrain (the stone generator skips isResourceRock) — filter for host stone** · **a Graphic_Linked's base material is the whole ATLAS SHEET; only ever use it via MaterialAtlasPool.SubMaterialFromAtlas — drawn flat it reads as rows of glyphs** · **"can't happen" fallback branches are exactly what the player photographs — make bad states unrepresentable instead** · never a queue-above-cutout cover · clip custom geometry to cells you already own · vertex colour on terrain materials dims the real texture (multiply) · statics keyed by game-scoped ids leak — CWT · never cache comps while Scribe active · FinalizeInit = worker thread · altitude ≠ draw order but IS the cutout depth tiebreaker · material.shader assignment resets renderQueue · green build proves nothing about reflectively-instantiated classes · **when art is locked in asset bundles, playtest screenshots are a legitimate mockup source**.

# 14. PUBLISHING
Store page honest (update after verification). known-issues.json v2 (no-elevator + hard-fog-squares entries stale). Live item **3773267907**.

## TESTING RULE
`isolated=true`. Companions: `astryl.Circinus` + `astryl.ModernDevTools` + `BiomesTeam.BiomesCaverns` + `BiomesTeam.CoreFramework` (+ BM only for compat runs). New colony for banding; reload tests need load-while-playing. Transit logging + watchdog reset every launch.
